summary: Ranking experiment 2 hardens the measurement: mixed field+distractor pool (1126 papers), graded 0-3 relevance rubric, union plus random-sample labelling and graded P@k, plus a blind spot-check sheet. Result: the strict threshold now separates the trivial recency baseline (P@5>=3 0.40) from both profile systems (1.00), but those two tie at the ceiling, so no method ranking is claimed and E-RANKING stays not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 7afd07b. Tooling/tests/registries/docs; labels cached in .local.

budget_impact.rationale: No runtime-provider call. Evaluation annotator spend this unit: 9 calls, ~50k tokens (~4,224 cached hidden prefix each). Runtime ceilings and operations unchanged. Labels cache so re-runs spend nothing.
budget_impact.before: Single-slice pool pre-filtered to the field, boolean labels, 96% positive, no discrimination.
budget_impact.after: Mixed 1126-paper pool, graded labels with variance, strict-threshold P@5 separates recency from profile ranking; keyword vs TF-IDF still tied.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Cached labels; graded P@k and relevance distribution

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; measurement tooling only, not recommendation quality

open_risks: n=45 labels, only 5 items in top-5: not statistically meaningful.
Annotator remains an unvalidated proxy; blind spot-check sheet not yet filled by the owner.
Within-field annotator variance is low, so method ranking between keyword and TF-IDF is still undetermined.
